message: Android 0.1.63 (64) is available through the official direct-download lane. User media intake now checks exact SHA-256 content within the target card. The same photo or video is skipped even when its file name or source URI changes, while the same content remains allowed in another card and soft-deleted content does not block reimport. The guard covers system album and file intake, pending case or collection forms, camera capture, and external sharing. Duplicate skips are reported clearly and leave no database or private-file residue. Backup restore, case-package import, and intentional annotated copies retain their existing behavior. Retained-data upgrades and duplicate import behavior were accepted on AOSP and OPPO. The final signed APK passed 837 automated tests with zero failures or skips, full lint with zero errors, R8, APK v2 signature, 16 KiB alignment, signing checks, and launch-readiness boundaries. Tencent AppBao currently continues to serve 0.1.53 (54); a store update is a separate submission and review.
